description: This file contains functions for handling symbolic links and directory path checks, including caching mechanisms for filesystem stat calls, and functions for scheduling and removing directories, specifically related to symlink and directory existence checks in a Git-related environment.

methods.name: threaded_check_leading_path
methods.description: Checks if the leading path component of a given path has a symlink or exists as a directory, with caching.

methods.name: threaded_has_dirs_only_path
methods.description: Checks if all path components of a given path exist as directories, with caching.

methods.name: schedule_dir_for_removal
methods.description: Schedules directories for removal, managing nested directory deletions.

methods.name: remove_scheduled_dirs
methods.description: Removes all directories scheduled for removal.

methods.name: invalidate_lstat_cache
methods.description: Resets the cached filesystem stat information.

methods.name: lstat_cache_aware_rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory and invalidates cache if successful.
